headline: Restructuring charge dents GAAP profit, revenue growth holds

drivers.explanation: Fell to $0.59 from $1.39 entirely because of a $106 million restructuring charge (91 cents/share); excluding it GAAP EPS would have topped the $1.39-$1.47 guidance range.
The 880bp y/y and 670bp q/q compression is fully attributable to the $106 million restructuring charge booked in operating expenses this quarter.
Growth to $1.84 from $1.72 reflects profitability held excluding restructuring and other one-time items; landed at the midpoint of the $1.81-$1.87 guidance range.
Growth was led by managed services, which posted record revenue of $791 million (67% of total), up 2.5% y/y.
Decline versus last year reflects $21 million of restructuring payments this quarter; excluding those, free cash flow was $193 million.
Company signed a 10-year strategic engagement with Liberty Latin America to manage its entire IT domain via Amdocs' aOS platform, the first proof point of its new four-pillar growth strategy.

summary_short: Revenue rose 2.7% year-over-year to $1.175 billion, at the midpoint of guidance, while a $106 million restructuring charge cut GAAP diluted EPS to $0.59 from $1.39; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.84 was up from $1.72 and at the midpoint of guidance.
summary_long: Fiscal Q3 revenue of $1.175 billion rose 2.7% year-over-year (2.2% constant currency), at the midpoint of guidance, led by record managed-services revenue of $791 million (67% of total). GAAP operating margin fell to 8.9%, down 880bp year-over-year, entirely on a $106 million restructuring charge; excluding it GAAP EPS would have exceeded guidance. Non-GAAP operating margin rose to 21.6%. Free cash flow was $172 million ($193 million excluding restructuring payments); the company repurchased $143 million of shares and raised its quarterly dividend to $0.569/share. Backlog reached $4.26 billion, up 2.7% year-over-year. Amdocs narrowed full-year revenue-growth guidance to 3.2%-4.0% and guided Q4 revenue to $1,175-$1,215 million, alongside a new 10-year IT deal with Liberty Latin America.
